features:
Note: Xeno and Solara isn't supported!
🎯 NEW UPD12: Flexible Targeting & Target Filters 
• Smart Priority: Choose how to prioritize targets: Closest, Highest Rarity, or Lowest HP. 
• Advanced Filters: Use the multi-select dropdowns to filter specific Rarities or Fish IDs. You can hunt exactly what you want! 
• Mutation Logic: Options to Prioritize Mutation (target mutated fish first) or Only Mutated (ignore everything else). • Stick to Target: Prevents the script from constantly switching targets. It will lock onto one fish until it's defeated.

🔒 NEW: Auto Lock System 
• Protect Your Loot: Located in the Sell Tab. You can now select specific fish from the dropdown menu to "Lock" them. 
• Safe Selling: Locked fish will be completely ignored by the Auto Sell feature, ensuring you never accidentally sell your rare catches!

⚡ NEW: Advanced Auto Skill 
• Smart Execution: The auto skill system has been completely reworked. It now uses a precise sequence (Equip -> Use -> Unequip) with optimized delays. 
• Better Detection: Improved probing logic to correctly identify which skills you own and their cooldowns.

🛠️ BUG FIXES & IMPROVEMENTS
• Auto Load Fixed: Fixed a critical bug where AutoFarm would turn off by itself when loading a config. Your settings now load correctly! 
• Unload Safety: Fixed the issue where your character would be flung when closing the script. 
• UI Section Improvements

Advanced Auto Farm: Supports multiple modes including Closest, Lowest HP, Focused, and Mutation Mode (Locks onto mutated fish until caught).

Smart Boss Hunter: Automatically targets Bosses. Includes a Smart Server Hop feature that hops servers if the Boss cooldown is greater than 30 seconds.

Shop Automation: "Auto Progress" mode to automatically buy Harpoons in order (from cheapest to expensive) or Auto Buy specific selected tools.

Auto Sell with adjustable delay.

Auto Claim Album.

Teleports: Auto Teleport to Chests and NPC Navigator.

Player Modifications: Adjustable WalkSpeed, JumpPower, Noclip, Infinite Jump, and Cursor Unlocker.

System: Complete Config System (Save/Load/Auto Load), Anti-AFK, and Auto Reconnect (rejoins if kicked/disconnected).
